name: governed-data-local
description: The Chapter 11 governed-data tools, running on this computer over stdio.
long_description: Packages the semantic layer, the validator, the warehouse, and its access policies into one install. Identity comes from the Identity setting on the extension's page, so whoever uses this computer decides who they are. Use it for a single developer's offline work, not for analysts.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Whose data access the server applies: analyst, emea-analyst, or finance.

tools.name: navigate_catalog
tools.description: Find the governed metrics that match a business concept.

tools.name: generate_governed_sql
tools.description: Generate validated SQL for one catalog metric.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Run generated SQL under the identity's data access policies.
